timeModel: All frame fields are absolute 0-based integer timeline frames. Content frames are addressed by contentFrameId.

protocolVersion.description: Set to route `command.type` as a canonical operation even when it shares a legacy command name (load_project, undo, resize_canvas, generators…). Implied by expectedRevision.

command.description: Operation name in `type` plus the operation input fields (canonical ops), or a legacy command

requestId.description: Echo of state_request.requestId (absent for unsolicited snapshots)

state_snapshot.description: v3 fields; legacy canvas/animation/layers fields are still included for older servers

Char.description: Single visible character (one code point; surrogate pairs allowed)

clear.description: Erase the cell instead of writing it

Style.description: Drawing style; omitted fields use the current tool state

frame.description: Timeline frame used to resolve the content frame; defaults to the playhead

createIfMissing.description: Create a 1-frame content frame at `frame` when none covers it (default false → NOT_FOUND)

Target.description: Explicit edit target. Edits apply in layer-local cell coordinates.

Value.description: Keyframe/setting value: number, boolean, string or mapping object

Artifact.description: File produced in the browser without triggering a download

Session.description: Native .asciimtn session (SessionDataV2) exactly as the app saves it

ids.description: Created/affected ids keyed by kind (e.g. layerId, blockId, keyframeIds). Mirrors the flat *Id/*Ids fields.

noChange.description: True when the operation left the document unchanged (no revision bump)

Mutation.description: Mutation result: ids map, the new document revision, plus operation-specific fields

text.description: One string per row of region (format "text")

truncated.description: True when count exceeds the inline cell limit (2000)

position.description: Index of the last applied entry (-1 when none)

defaults.description: Supported import settings with defaults; palette defaults reflect the active palettes

enums.description: Allowed values for enumerated import settings

resolvedSettings.description: Settings after keyframe interpolation at the requested frame

operations.name: get_capabilities
operations.description: Contract/version info, supported operations, runtime catalogs summary, auth and entitlement state.

operations.name: get_document
operations.description: Full native project session (.asciimtn v2) including layers, groups, effects, shaders, generators, typography, palettes and tool state.

operations.name: get_document_summary
operations.description: Compact structure: canvas, timeline, layers/groups with content-frame ranges, effects, shaders, selection and history flags. No cell data.

operations.name: read_cells
operations.description: Read cells at a timeline frame. scope "composite" = app compositor output (transforms, effects, generators; shaders excluded). scope "layer" = raw content frame data in layer-local coordinates.

operations.name: get_catalog
operations.description: Runtime catalogs: effect/shader/generator types with property schemas, palettes, export formats and settings, FIGlet fonts, box styles, brush shapes, autofill palettes.

operations.name: get_selection
operations.description: Current selection mask (cells, bounds) and clipboard availability.

operations.name: get_history
operations.description: Undo/redo availability and recent history descriptions.

operations.name: new_project
operations.description: Reset to a new blank project (same as File → New): one layer, cleared history, detached from cloud.

operations.name: load_project
operations.description: Replace the open project with a native session (v1 or v2) using the app importer.

operations.name: set_project_metadata
operations.description: Set project name and/or description.

operations.name: resize_canvas
operations.description: Resize canvas across all layers/content frames, keeping content pinned to anchor (default top-left).

operations.name: crop_canvas
operations.description: Crop the canvas to a region (or the current selection bounds) across all layers.

operations.name: set_canvas_background
operations.description: Set canvas background color ("transparent" allowed).

operations.name: set_typography
operations.description: Set font, font size, character spacing and line spacing used for rendering/export.

operations.name: set_tool_state
operations.description: Set current drawing character/colors and active tool (used as defaults by drawing operations).

operations.name: set_cells
operations.description: Write or erase cells in one content frame.

operations.name: clear_cells
operations.description: Erase a region, the current selection, or the whole content frame.

operations.name: fill_region
operations.description: Fill a rectangular region or the current selection with one cell style.

operations.name: import_text
operations.description: Place multi-line plain text; spaces become blank cells unless keepSpaces.

operations.name: shift_content
operations.description: Shift all cells of a content frame by dx/dy, optionally wrapping around the canvas.

operations.name: flip_content
operations.description: Flip a region, the selection, or the whole canvas horizontally/vertically.

operations.name: replace_in_cells
operations.description: Find/replace characters and/or colors in non-empty cells of one content frame, a layer, or the whole project. match: {} matches every non-empty cell. region/useSelection restrict the edit to those cells (scope "content_frame" only); unmatched fields of each cell are preserved.

useSelection.description: Restrict to the current selection mask (no coordinates need to be transferred)

operations.name: draw_brush_stroke
operations.description: Pencil/eraser stroke through points with brush size and shape (aspect-ratio aware, respects selection mask).

operations.name: draw_line
operations.description: Straight line between two cells (Bresenham), optional brush size.

operations.name: draw_shape
operations.description: Rectangle or ellipse via the vector-shape engine (filled or outline, constant/palette/autofill/lineart fill).

operations.name: draw_bezier
operations.description: Bezier path (open stroke or closed shape) rasterized by the pen-tool engine. Coordinates are cell units (fractional allowed); handles are relative.

operations.name: fill_area
operations.description: Paint-bucket fill from a seed cell (contiguous or global, match by char/color/bgColor).

operations.name: gradient_fill
operations.description: Gradient fill (linear/radial) of a seed fill area or region, interpolating character, text color and/or background color stops.

operations.name: draw_ascii_box
operations.description: Box-drawing rectangle or connected line path with junction-aware characters.

operations.name: place_text
operations.description: Type text at a position (text tool); newlines advance rows.

operations.name: place_figlet_text
operations.description: Render FIGlet ASCII-type text with a font/layout and stamp it at a position.

operations.name: add_layer
operations.description: Add a content layer (with an empty content frame spanning the timeline).

operations.name: remove_layer
operations.description: Delete a layer.

operations.name: duplicate_layer
operations.description: Duplicate a layer with all content, keyframes and effects.

operations.name: reorder_layer
operations.description: Move a layer to an index (0 = bottom of stack).

operations.name: update_layer
operations.description: Update layer name, visibility, solo, lock, opacity, keyframe sync or static transform properties.

staticProperties.description: Static transform values keyed by property path

operations.name: set_active_layer
operations.description: Select the active (editable) layer.

operations.name: merge_layers
operations.description: Merge a layer down, or merge all visible layers.

operations.name: flatten_layer
operations.description: Bake transforms/effects of a layer into its content frames.

operations.name: create_group
operations.description: Group layers.

layerIds.description: Two or more distinct layers not already in a group (the app has no empty groups)

operations.name: ungroup
operations.description: Dissolve a group, keeping its layers.

operations.name: update_group
operations.description: Update group name, visibility, solo, lock, collapsed or static transform properties.

operations.name: add_content_frame
operations.description: Add a content frame to a layer at an explicit time range (must not overlap).

operations.name: remove_content_frame
operations.description: Delete a content frame.

operations.name: update_content_frame
operations.description: Retime, rename, hide or label a content frame.

operations.name: duplicate_content_frame
operations.description: Duplicate a content frame immediately after itself (shifting later frames).

operations.name: split_content_frame
operations.description: Split a content frame at an absolute frame.

operations.name: set_timeline
operations.description: Set frame rate, duration, looping and work area.

operations.name: trim_to_work_area
operations.description: Trim the timeline to the enabled work area.

operations.name: remove_blank_space
operations.description: Close an empty gap on a layer at a frame (ripple earlier content forward).

operations.name: seek
operations.description: Move the playhead to an absolute frame.

operations.name: set_playback
operations.description: Start/stop preview playback in the browser.

operations.name: set_onion_skin
operations.description: Configure onion skinning.

operations.name: set_keyframes
operations.description: Upsert transform keyframes on a layer or group property track (creates the track).

replace.description: Replace all existing keyframes on the track

operations.name: remove_keyframes
operations.description: Remove transform keyframes by frame or id, or clear the track.

operations.name: add_effect
operations.description: Add a procedural effect block to a layer, group or global track.

settings.description: Effect settings keyed by property path (see get_catalog)

operations.name: update_effect
operations.description: Update effect settings, enabled state, timing, owner or stack index.

settings.description: Effect settings keyed by property path (see get_catalog)

operations.name: remove_effect
operations.description: Remove an effect block.

operations.name: set_effect_keyframes
operations.description: Upsert keyframes on an effect property.

replace.description: Replace all existing keyframes on the track

operations.name: remove_effect_keyframes
operations.description: Remove effect keyframes.

operations.name: bake_effect
operations.description: Apply an effect destructively to layer content and remove the block.

operations.name: add_shader
operations.description: Add a shader (post-processing) block.

settings.description: Effect settings keyed by property path (see get_catalog)

operations.name: update_shader
operations.description: Update shader settings, enabled state, timing or chain index.

settings.description: Effect settings keyed by property path (see get_catalog)

operations.name: remove_shader
operations.description: Remove a shader block.

operations.name: set_shader_keyframes
operations.description: Upsert keyframes on a shader property.

replace.description: Replace all existing keyframes on the track

operations.name: remove_shader_keyframes
operations.description: Remove shader keyframes.

operations.name: get_generator_catalog
operations.description: Generator types with property schemas.

operations.name: add_generator_layer
operations.description: Add a procedural generator layer, optionally with initial keyframe tracks (one undo entry). Returns layerId plus trackIds/keyframeIds in keyframes[] order.

replace.description: Replace all existing keyframes on the track

operations.name: update_generator_layer
operations.description: Update generator settings/timing/name/enabled.

operations.name: set_generator_property
operations.description: Set one generator property (keyframes it when animated or frame given).

operations.name: set_generator_keyframes
operations.description: Upsert generator property keyframes.

replace.description: Replace all existing keyframes on the track

operations.name: remove_generator_keyframes
operations.description: Remove generator keyframes.

operations.name: reset_generator
operations.description: Reset generator settings to defaults.

operations.name: randomize_generator_seed
operations.description: Randomize generator seed.

operations.name: get_generator_state
operations.description: Generator source and evaluated settings at a frame.

operations.name: render_generator_frames
operations.description: Render generator output for frames (browser renderer).

operations.name: bake_generator_layer
operations.description: Bake generator output into content frames.

operations.name: set_selection
operations.description: Select a rectangle, explicit cells, a polygon (lasso) or all cells matching a color/char (magic wand).

operations.name: clear_selection
operations.description: Clear all selections.

operations.name: copy_selection
operations.description: Copy (or cut) the selected cells of a content frame to the app clipboard. Copy without cut does not create history.

operations.name: paste_clipboard
operations.description: Paste the app clipboard at a position (defaults to the original bounds).

operations.name: move_selection
operations.description: Move selected cells by dx/dy (selection follows).

operations.name: undo
operations.description: Undo the last app history entry (same as Cmd/Ctrl+Z).

operations.name: redo
operations.description: Redo (same as Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z).

ids.description: Always empty for batches; see results[i].result.ids

operations.name: apply_operations
operations.description: Apply up to 100 document mutations atomically: one revision, one undo entry, full rollback on any failure. Sub-operations must be non-nested document mutations (not undo/redo/new_project/load_project/apply_operations, reads, view, or io). Later steps see earlier steps' results; failures report details.index/details.op.

input.description: Input for the sub-operation (validated against its schema)

operations.name: set_active_palette
operations.description: Activate a color or character palette.

operations.name: create_palette
operations.description: Create a custom color palette (colors) or character palette (characters).

operations.name: update_palette
operations.description: Rename a custom palette or replace its colors/characters.

operations.name: delete_palette
operations.description: Delete a custom palette.

operations.name: duplicate_palette
operations.description: Duplicate any palette as a custom palette.

operations.name: import_palette
operations.description: Import a palette from the app JSON palette format.

operations.name: export_palette
operations.description: Export a palette as the app JSON palette file.

operations.name: import_media
operations.description: Convert an image/video (base64) to ASCII with the app import pipeline; place as a new layer or into a target content frame. Image-only overlay merges non-empty converted cells, preserving existing artwork elsewhere.

startTime.description: Seconds into the clip to start sampling (default 0)

duration.description: Seconds to sample (default: to the end)

frameRate.description: Sampling rate in fps; also each frame's duration (default: detected source rate)

video.description: Video sampling window (video/* only). Omit to import every source frame.

settings.description: Import settings overrides; allowed keys, enums and defaults: get_catalog tools.importSettings. Unsupported keys are rejected.

operations.name: set_image_trace
operations.description: Load/clear/configure the image-trace reference overlay (not saved in the project).

operations.name: export
operations.description: Render an export with the app exporters and return it as an artifact (no browser download). Allowed settings and defaults per format: get_catalog export_formats (unsupported keys are rejected). Animated formats accept frameRange "all" | {start,end} (end -1 = last); the result reports the exported frameRange and any derived componentName/packageName/modelName.

operations.name: list_cloud_projects
operations.description: List cloud projects (or trash).

operations.name: save_cloud_project
operations.description: Save the open project to the cloud (update linked project, or create).

operations.name: open_cloud_project
operations.description: Open a cloud project in the editor.

operations.name: delete_cloud_project
operations.description: Move a cloud project to trash.

operations.name: restore_cloud_project
operations.description: Restore a cloud project from trash.

operations.name: permanently_delete_cloud_project
operations.description: Permanently delete a trashed cloud project.

operations.name: update_cloud_project_metadata
operations.description: Rename or re-describe a cloud project.

operations.name: download_cloud_project
operations.description: Download a cloud project as a .asciimtn artifact without opening it.

operations.name: upload_session_to_cloud
operations.description: Upload a native session as a new cloud project.

operations.name: publish_cloud_project
operations.description: Publish a saved cloud project to the community gallery (preview rendered in browser).

operations.name: remix_cloud_project
operations.description: Remix a published gallery project into your cloud projects and open it.
